# Test frames

These are crops from the RMRP screenshots supplied with the request; they contain only the area needed by the detector, not the chat, player name, or the full desktop. They are gzip-compressed raw **BGRA**, top-down and tightly packed (four bytes per pixel).

The 1920×1080 reference frames are 541×381 pixels, cropped at `[620, 360, 1161, 741)`. The 1280×720 frames are 361×254 pixels, cropped using the same floor/ceiling rules as `WindowsGamePort`; they were generated by scaling the supplied screenshots, not recorded in-game at 720p. The positive fixtures show the casting and reeling HUD; the negative fixtures show the idle and inventory screens.

`cast-boat` comes from a later user-supplied 681×232 crop. Only its bar and hook were kept; the player name and surrounding screen are not included. Its original full-screen position is unknown, so the bar was **reconstructed** at the expected reference position rather than used as evidence of its real client coordinates. The 720p version is a scaled reconstruction. Tests that move its white pixels simulate motion and are not a recorded game sequence.

`TestRunner.cs` supplies the matching client dimensions and crop origin to `PixelFrame`. No image library or game installation is required to run the tests.
